name: Summit AZ - Guardian Review Not-Indexed 2026-10-09
body:
> Audit · Summit Az · 2026-10-09

# Summary
An "SEO Compliance and Quality Guardian" review (read-only) of the six pages in GSC's "Crawled - currently not indexed" report (last updated Oct 4). Site-wide context on Oct 9: 187 indexed, 59 not indexed.

# Verdicts
| Page | Status | Decision |
|---|---|---|
| /drain-cleaning-services-tempe/ | Indexed (crawled Oct 4) | PASS, monitor |
| /drain-cleaning-services-queen-creek/ | Crawled not indexed, last crawl Jul 25 | PASS, request indexing |
| /drain-cleaning-services-scottsdale/ | Crawled not indexed, last crawl Jul 24 | PASS, request indexing |
| /plumbing-fixture-installation-in-apache-junction/ | Crawled not indexed, Jul 23 | BLOCK (major improvement) |
| /plumbing-fixture-installation-in-tempe/ | Crawled not indexed, Jul 23 | BLOCK |
| /plumbing-fixture-installation-in-gilbert/ | Crawled not indexed, Jul 7 | BLOCK |

BLOCK applies to the live copy, not to taking pages down; the safer path was a rewrite through drafts and approval.

# Key findings
- All six pass technical checks: 200, index/follow, self canonical, in the sitemap, 1,440 to 1,630 words, 15 to 18 in-content inbound links, Plumber/Service/FAQPage/BreadcrumbList schema, no rating markup. Hidden elements are form messages, not spam.
- Drain pages: claims match the verified profile, local facts are sourced, only shared template text (about 13%) overlaps.
- Fixture pages: confirmed doorway or scaled-content pattern (Gilbert about 77% and Tempe about 75% shared with Mesa), plus banned claims and pasted junk code.
- Baseline: 0 impressions for all six in the Search Atlas mirror (Aug 11 to Oct 8).

# Decisions and status
- The three fixture pages were rewritten and applied the same day (Oct 9); see [Summit AZ - Fixture Installation City Pages](lib:brain-summit-az-fixture-installation-city-pages). Measure from Oct 9.
